model.name: Demucs Stem Separation
model.description: Separate a song into drums, bass, vocals, and other stems.
model.author: example

inference.setup:
import tempfile

import torch
import torchaudio
from demucs.apply import apply_model
from demucs.pretrained import get_model

DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
_models = {}


def _load(name):
    if name not in _models:
        model = get_model(name)
        model.to(DEVICE)
        model.eval()
        _models[name] = model
    return _models[name]


def _save(tensor, sample_rate):
    out = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False)
    out.close()
    torchaudio.save(out.name, tensor.detach().cpu(), sample_rate)
    return out.name
